title: Home-Based Exercise Tele-Rehabilitation After COVID-19
official: Home-Based Exercise Tele-Rehabilitation in High-Risk Veterans: Impact of COVID-19 Exposure and Socioeconomic Factors
summary: The Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic has resulted in catastrophic infections and fatalities across the nation. Many older Veterans with comorbidities are especially vulnerable to complications and poor recovery. This award will investigate the effect of a novel, home-based, supervised, group exercise tele-rehabilitation in Veterans recovered from COVID-19 on cardiopulmonary and physical function.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Veteran
* documented COVID-19 \> 90 days ago
* diagnosis of 2 of following conditions: hypertension, diabetes, cardiovascular disease, chronic kidney disease, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease OR 1 condition and BMI \> 30 kilograms per square meter (kg/m2)

Exclusion Criteria:

* myocardial infarction (within 3 months)
* exertional or unstable angina (chest pain that limits activity)
* severe congestive heart failure (EF \< 20% in last year or NYHA Classification III or IV)
* uncontrolled hypertension (systolic blood pressure\>180 \&/or diastolic blood pressure\> 110 millimeters of mercury at screening)
* screening electrocardiogram (EKG) with ischemia, complex arrhythmia, or high-grade block (per Minnesota Code)
* poorly controlled diabetes mellitus (fasting blood sugar\>200 milligrams per deciliter, random blood sugar \> 299 milligrams per deciliter, or HbA1C \> 10)
* treatment for cancer except skin cancer (within 3 months)
* peripheral vascular disease with claudication
* severe arthritis limiting ambulation
* neurologic disease limiting ambulation (weakness requiring assist device; severe neuropathy)
* end stage liver disease (decompensated liver disease)
* End stage renal failure (dialysis)
* severe pulmonary disease (home oxygen, admission for dyspnea or pneumonia within 1 month)
* high fall risk (history of falls, bone fracture)
* dementia (based on Evaluation to Consent)
* signs or symptoms of any medical comorbidity that would preclude exercise testing or training
* exercises on routine basis (structured aerobic exercise \> 3 times per week)
sponsor: VA Office of Research and Development
